title: Add hardware-aware intake fingerprint, quant-suggestion engine, and audience-tailored release synopsis automator
author: Ethan Brooks
description: Context and motivation: as customers onboard larger open models we continue to get questions about recommended quantization profiles and hardware suitability. Current onboarding produces a generic perf profile and a dense changelog entry; customers then request bespoke quant/affinity advice for their hardware (A100, H100, RTX-class) which slows reviews. This PR introduces three coordinated features: (1) a deterministic hardware-aware 'intake fingerprint' that captures model memory/KV characteristics and peak transient working set; (2) a lightweight sampling micro-benchmark that runs as part of intake to produce a short performance histogram across representative sequence lengths; and (3) a quantization-suggestion engine that maps the fingerprint+microbench to ranked quant profiles and a rollback-safety score. Finally, a release synopsis automator synthesizes an audience-aware short blurb for release notes (developer, SRE, product) to reduce manual release copywork.
summary_of_changes: Implementation: added registry/intake/fingerprint.py with stable fingerprint schema and provenance header; integrated sample_microbench into intake flow; quant_suggester implements a rule-and-ML hybrid mapping (heuristics + small tree model trained on past onboarding signals) and emits suggested quant profiles and expected delta in token cost; stamps.py adds signed metadata stamps for fingerprint and suggestion sets; synopsis_automator creates brief natural-language summaries tailored by audience tag; added tests and a CI bench workflow. API: intake_handler exposes a /v1/intake endpoint flag to opt-in to microbench. Docs: onboarding guidance and QA checklist updated. Rollout: feature gated behind feature flag registry.intake.hw_fingerprint; default off for existing customers.
commits_summary: 4 commits: (1) add deterministic fingerprint and schema + unit tests; (2) add microbench harness and exporter, wire into intake path; (3) quant suggestion engine + scoring and stamps; (4) synopsis automator, docs, and CI workflow. Key commit messages: 'intake: deterministic hw fingerprint + provenance', 'intake: sample microbench harness and exporter', 'heuristics: quant suggestion engine with rollback-safety scoring', 'tools: release synopsis automator and docs'.
changed_areas_high_level: Core intake pipeline (deterministic fingerprinting and microbench sampling), quant recommendation heuristics and lightweight model, release tooling for automated synopses, provenance stamps and versioned profile output, new unit and integration tests, CI bench workflow for reproducible microbench runs.
testing_and_validation: Unit tests for fingerprint stability and stamps; integration tests exercising intake->quant-suggester mapping; microbench run in CI against a small fixture model to verify histogram shape and exporter metrics; manual validation on internal H100 and A100 runners with three representative models (small/medium/large) to compare suggested quant profiles against prior baseline. Perf benchmarks included in PR; overall microbench runtime kept sub-60s for opt-in runs.
rollout_plan: Merged behind gated feature flag registry.intake.hw_fingerprint=false by default. Early access enabled for TrustedOnboarders cohort. Phase 1: opt-in internal teams and early customers; Phase 2: enable for self-serve with opt-out via account setting; Phase 3: default-on for new onboardings after telemetry stabilization. Monitoring: add alerts for microbench failures, large variance in suggested quant deltas, and rollback-safety score regressions.
compatibility_notes: No breaking changes to existing intake schema unless hw_fingerprint is enabled. Suggested profiles are additive metadata; users can opt to ignore suggestions. Stamps are backwards-compatible (new optional header).
review_thread: Maya Alvarez (reviewer): Can we make the fingerprint schema extensible for future HW attributes? Request: add schema versioning and a clear migration test - addressed in stamps.py and profile_versioner.py, added tests.
Jonah Kim (reviewer): microbench runtime feels long for large models. Suggest a configurable sample budget - added sample_budget env and default to minimal probe sequence lengths. Updated docs.psf
Sofia Petrov (approver): Minor nit on wording in synopsis templates, approved after fix.
Ethan Brooks (author): replied to all comments, added follow-up tasks: ENG-4725 to expand the training dataset for the suggestion model, and ENG-4721 to add cloud-region-aware suggestions.
release_notes: Added hardware-aware intake fingerprint and opt-in microbench to generate deterministic model HW signatures; introduced quantization-suggestion engine which recommends ranked quant profiles and a rollback-safety score; automated audience-tailored release synopses for onboarding changes. Feature is gated behind registry.intake.hw_fingerprint and rolled out to early access cohorts. Notes: suggestions are advisory; continue to validate on customer's production workloads.
additional_notes: Follow-ups created: ENG-4725 (augment suggestion training data), ENG-4750 (expose rollback-safety to console), ENG-4782 (add more device labels for SMB GPUs). Included example config in examples/onboard-sample/hw-probe.yaml.
